verdict.rationale: Stripe documents managing locations and zones on an API track (the docs-4 URL is the API variant), and it documents reader registration by registration code, serial number, or order number, with readers required to belong to a location. Serial-number registration works without the device in hand, which suits remote provisioning. However, the evidence never shows reader registration exposed as an API call, and the general Stripe MCP server is not shown to cover Terminal location or reader operations, so an agent-driven end-to-end flow is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoint for registering readers to a location, evidence that agent tooling (MCP/CLI) covers Terminal provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of an automated end-to-end location setup.
